briefing: - 今日清单未观测到在野利用与勒索软件关联。
- 集中披露4个漏洞，其中3个CVSS≥9，属批量高危。
- 容器/虚拟化硬编码凭据CVSS 9.4，优先轮换凭据。

items.title: Unla OAuth2认证绕过可获取令牌
items.title_zh: Unla OAuth2认证绕过可获取令牌
items.summary_zh: 未认证者可注册客户端,经 /authorize 换码、/token 兑换令牌,访问受保护 MCP 与上游 API 凭据。
items.action_zh: 关注厂商修复;临时限制 /authorize、/token 公网访问并轮换上游凭据。
items.repro_note: 注册客户端→/authorize取code→/token换令牌,无需资源所有者认证
items.impact_scope: AI/MCP 网关,可代理上游 API 凭据
items.description: AmoyLab Unla through 0.10.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain valid access tokens because the OAuth2 server never authenticates a resource owner. Attackers can register a client, request a code from /authorize, and exchange it at /token to access OAuth2-protected MCP prefixes, proxied upstream APIs and injected credentials.

items.title: Modem OTA SIB1 解析栈溢出
items.title_zh: Modem OTA SIB1 解析栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 恶意基站广播含畸形调度信息的 SIB1,无需权限即可触发栈溢出,导致远程代码执行或拒绝服务。
items.action_zh: 跟踪基带/芯片厂商 OTA 补丁并及时升级;避免驻留不可信网络。
items.repro_note: 需伪基站射频环境广播构造 SIB1,无法纯软件本地复现
items.impact_scope: 手机/物联网基带,可被伪基站远程触发
items.description: In the modem OTA stack, there is a possible stack-based buffer overflow due to improper validation of scheduling information in SIB1 messages. This could lead to remote code execution or denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed.

items.title: agnai 硬编码管理员凭据与JWT密钥
items.title_zh: agnai 硬编码管理员凭据与JWT密钥
items.summary_zh: 自托管部署使用固定管理员口令与公开JWT密钥,未认证者可登录管理员或伪造 admin 令牌接管实例。
items.action_zh: 更换 compose 中管理员口令与 JWT 密钥并重建实例,关注官方修复。
items.repro_note: 用compose内置口令登录,或用公开JWT密钥自签admin令牌
items.impact_scope: 自托管 AI 对话服务,常暴露公网
items.description: Agnaistic agnai through 1.0.555 contains a hard-coded credentials vulnerability in self-host.docker-compose.yml, which sets a fixed admin password and public JWT secret. Unauthenticated attackers can log in as admin or sign their own JWT with admin: true to impersonate users, reset passwords, and change server configuration.

items.title: BotSharp 硬编码JWT密钥致令牌伪造
items.title_zh: BotSharp 硬编码JWT密钥致令牌伪造
items.summary_zh: WebStarter 配置中JWT密钥硬编码,未认证者可用其签发 admin 令牌,冒充任意用户访问受保护 API。
items.action_zh: 轮换 Jwt:Key 并外部化管理,升级至 5.2.0 之后版本。
items.impact_scope: 内网 .NET AI 应用,API 横向访问
items.description: BotSharp through 5.2.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to forge bearer tokens using the hard-coded Jwt:Key in WebStarter appsettings.json. Attackers can sign tokens with the committed HMAC secret and fixed botsharp issuer and audience to impersonate any known user, including administrators, on Authorize-protected API routes.
